name: Customer Acquisition Efficiency
summary: Calculates CAC and CAC payback per channel and blended for a period, and compares channels on spend versus customers won.
description: Takes spend and new customers per acquisition channel for one period, plus revenue per customer and gross margin, and calculates each channel's CAC, CAC payback in months, share of spend and of customers, an efficiency index, and the blended totals. Channels that won no customers get no CAC rather than an infinite one. Who it's for: founders, growth and marketing leads deciding where to put acquisition budget. Limitations: it assumes one channel per customer (no multi-touch attribution) and the same revenue and margin for customers from every channel; spend and customers must cover the same period.
problems: Which acquisition channel has the lowest CAC
Compare CAC payback across marketing channels
Where should we move our ad budget

inputs.label: Period
inputs.description: The period the spend and customers cover.

inputs.label: Revenue per customer per month
inputs.description: Average monthly revenue from one customer.

inputs.label: Gross margin %
inputs.description: Gross margin on that revenue, in percent.

inputs.label: Channels
inputs.description: Each channel with its spend and new customers in the period.
inputs.example:
Ads: spent 10,000, 50 new customers
Events: 15,000, 20 customers

outputs.label: Calculated results
outputs.description: Results with units, formulas, assumptions and warnings, from the registered calculation.

outputs.label: Explanation
outputs.description: What the results mean, with numbers taken only from the calculation.

execution.system: You are an analyst explaining calculated results to a business decision-maker. Be concrete and brief.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on what the results mean for the decision, using only calculated numbers.
summary.title: Summary

text.description: One point. Numbers only from the calculated results.

steps.name: Read your data
steps.responsibility: Copy your figures into the calculation's input exactly as written.
steps.prompt: Read each channel with its spend and number of new customers. Copy amounts exactly as written, without currency symbols.

steps.name: Calculate
steps.responsibility: Runs the registered acquisition_efficiency@1 calculation. All numbers in the result come from here.

steps.name: Explain
steps.responsibility: Explains the calculated results; adds no numbers of its own.
steps.prompt: Explain which channels are most and least efficient, how blended CAC compares, and where budget could move. Mention every warning.

steps.name: Check explanation
steps.responsibility: Every number in the explanation matches the calculated results or your inputs.

criteria.description: Every number in the summary comes from the calculation or your inputs.
Every number in the key points comes from the calculation or your inputs.
The summary is 90 words or fewer.
